answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation. We randomly sample 1,000 clips ... and ask annotators whether specific context information is necessary to generate the reference-quality narration... A human evaluation of 300 videos is selected, each accompanied by narrations generated by two distinct models. Three human annotators independently rank each pair of narrations...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked whether particular contextual information (plot history, character context, sound, dialogue) is needed, and to rank which of two model-generated narrations is better or if they are comparable.
